sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information to provide better services to our users. The types of information we collect include usage data and device information when you use our applications.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information
sections.content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services. This includes using data to fix bugs, analyze usage patterns, and develop new features.

sections.heading: 3. Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not share personal information with companies, organizations, or individuals outside of izowooi except in the following cases: with your consent, for legal reasons, or to protect our rights and safety.

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We work hard to protect our users from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction of information we hold. We use encryption and secure protocols to protect your data.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. You can also request a copy of your data or ask us to stop processing it.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post any privacy policy changes on this page and update the effective date. Please review this policy periodically.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at izowooi@hotmail.com.
